prompt: It is late June and people in Sydney, Australia, are wearing coats. Which season is it in Sydney, and why?

options.text: Summer, because Australia is closer to the Sun in June
Spring, because seasons start later below the equator
Autumn, because the oceans cool the land in June
Winter, because the Southern Hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun in June

explanation: In June Earth's tilt points the Southern Hemisphere away from the Sun, so Australia gets weaker, lower sunlight and has winter while the north has summer.
